entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kyung-Yung Lee, is a South Korean former professional boxer who competed from 1985 to 1993. He is the first boxer to win a world title in the mini-flyweight division. Lee held the International Boxing Federation (IBF) mini-flyweight title in 1987.
